output.headline: Northgate lose grip despite possession edge
output.text: Northgate trail 1-0 with momentum at -27 and chaos at 46. Gabe Moreno's 63.1-length pass, difficulty 82, was intercepted, then Ilan Cohen's 22.6 pass to Oscar Blum rebuilt progress. Patient possession is being tested by Ironvale's xG of 1.15.
